company.name: Ziroom
company.shortDescription: Ziroom is an rental services company provides home rental and property management services.
company.description: In 2011, Beijing Freedom Life Asset Management Co., Ltd. (referred to as “free”) was established in Beijing. It is different from the traditional intermediary leasing model. It is an O2O company that provides professional housing asset management services. Since its establishment six years ago, the number of freely managed houses has exceeded 600,000, the number of service owners has exceeded 300,000, and the number of free-standing customers has exceeded 1.4 million. It has been stationed in 9 cities across the country: Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Wuhan, Guangzhou, Tianjin, and Chengdu are the leaders of China's long-term rental apartments. On January 16, 2018, it was able to obtain RMB 4 million Series A financing led by Huaping Investment, Sequoia Capital China Fund and Tencent. Other investment institutions include Chinachem, Sunac China, and Transatlantic Investment. Source capital, channel, new hope and other institutions. This round of financing was provided by Huaxing Capital as the exclusive financial advisor and Han Kun as the legal advisor.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $500,000,000, or 23.58% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,103,951,330 to $6,600,000,000, a 2.13x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 17 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
